g1.label: 1. Flowers must not ___ (pick)
g1.why: Passive after a modal: modal + be + past participle.

g2.label: 2. Litter must not ___ (throw)
g2.why: Modal + be + past participle; 'throw' has the irregular participle 'thrown'.

g3.label: 3. Animals should not ___ (disturb)
g3.why: Passive after 'should not': be + past participle.

g5.label: 5. Aboriginal sites must not ___ (touch)
g5.why: The sites receive the action, so use modal + be + past participle.

g6.label: 6. The bush should not ___ (use)
g6.why: Passive after 'should not': be + past participle.

g7.label: 7. Trees and plants must not ___ (damage)
g7.why: Modal + be + past participle: must not be damaged.

g1.label: 1. Snakes can ___ (find)
g1.why: Passive after a modal: can + be + past participle.

g2.label: 2. You don't want ___ (bite)
g2.why: 'Want' takes the to-infinitive, so the passive is 'to be' + past participle.

g3.label: 3. Snakes like ___ (leave alone)
g3.why: 'Like' + passive to-infinitive: to be + past participle.

g6.label: 6. They should never ___ (pick up)
g6.why: Modal + be + past participle; the particle 'up' stays after the verb.

g7.label: 7. … or ___ (chase)
g7.why: Still after 'should never': be + past participle.

g8.label: 8. You'll need ___ (take) to hospital
g8.why: 'Need' takes the to-infinitive, so the passive is 'to be taken'.

g1.label: 1. You won't believe what I ___ (just / tell)
g1.why: Past passive: was + told, with 'just' after the auxiliary.

g2.label: 2. He ___ (last / see)
g2.why: Past passive with 'last' after 'was': was last seen.

g3.label: 3. I hope he ___ (rescue)
g3.why: Hoping about the future: will be + past participle (or present passive 'is rescued').

g4.label: 4. The smoke ___ (can – smell)
g4.why: Past of 'can' in the passive: could be + past participle.

g5.correct: didn't want to be shown around
accept: didn't want to be shown around
did not want to be shown around
g5.label: 5. I ___ (not want – show around)
g5.why: Past negative 'didn't want' + passive to-infinitive 'to be shown around'.

g6.label: 6. What we ___ (tell) at the hostel
g6.why: Past passive with 'we': were + past participle.

g7.label: 7. I ___ (tell) by the guide
g7.why: 'By the guide' shows the passive; past with 'I' is 'was told'.

g8.label: 8. They ___ (bring) to Australia
g8.why: Past passive: the camels were brought by people a long time ago.
